headline: No new events as lines drift
body: A quiet day with no scored events. All endings moved by less than 0.1 point as recent announcements faded; Gatekeeper slipped about 0.02 as the lift from earlier coordination news wore off. The world factors held steady, and Horizon Balance was nearly unchanged at -1.59.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Gatekeeper's -0.02 was the largest drift, from fading earlier news.
